headline: Apollo supplied a $305 million construction loan for 101 Franklin Street, a 72-unit Tribeca condo conversion.
Moinian Group modified the $131 million CMBS loan on 2 Washington Street in Battery Park City and signed Prism as the new tenant.
JPMorgan Chase provided a $90 million loan to Brause Realty to refinance The Lotus at 255 East 39th Street in Murray Hill.
Mitchell & Titus signed an 11-year headquarters lease at One Battery Park Plaza, bringing the tower to 99% leased.
